t: For those wondering what PASABUY means, it is a pun derived from the tagalog word, "pasabay" meaning to do something together or to ask someone a favor to do something on your behalf. Changing the last syllable "-bay" to the english word "-buy", simply put, you're asking someone to buy something for you. Pasabuy was common during the peak of the COVID pandemic. Since a lot of people can't go out of their houses, the people who can come out (especially during the lockdown) offer to buy them things and essentials.
